top_signals.title: Intel hits construction milestone at Ohio chip fab that’s at least 5 years behind schedule
top_signals.summary: Intel has installed the first major structural truss at its delayed Ohio chip fab, but the company has yet to announce a major outside customer.

top_signals.title: Will AI erase all meritocracy?
top_signals.summary: AI means “intelligence” is now directly correlated with how much money you can spend on compute. What does this mean for meritocracy?
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Supplies of rare earth yttrium have ‘stalled,’ industry ministry official says
top_signals.summary: The official described a "supply-demand crunch," with the Financial Times reporting that Tokyo is months away from running out of the critical metal.
